observation.visible_scene: A wide, eye-level view of a slow, glassy river or pond fringed by dense green summer trees. A pale rock pokes out of the water on the left, a fallen log and brush line the right bank, and a short stretch of white-water rapids sits in the center background. The still water mirrors the tree canopy and a bright sky.
visible_changes: The water surface keeps rippling, so the reflected trees and the bright sky patch continuously shimmer and deform (reflection distortion, not separate moving objects).
The white-water rapids in the background flow steadily throughout.
A few tiny floating leaves/specks on the near water drift only marginally.
The camera framing and the rock, banks, and tree silhouettes stay fixed in position across the segment; no pan, tilt, or zoom is evident.
outside_clip_unknowns: The segment is an arbitrary slice of a continuous static shot; no onset or completion of any action occurs, and the cause of the water flow is unseen.
uncertain_details: Whether the small floating bits genuinely translate or only appear to move due to reflection shimmer is hard to confirm.
Sub-pixel handheld jitter cannot be fully ruled out, though the shot looks essentially static.
